=={{header|FreeBASIC}}==
In FreeBASIC, source file inclusion is achieved using the <code>#include [once] "file"</code> preprocessor directive, which allows source code from other files to be inserted at the point where they appear, facilitating code reuse and the modular organization of programs.

This is useful for removing code from a file and splitting it into multiple files. It is helpful to have a single file with declarations in a program consisting of multiple modules. Files can be included within an include file, although including the original file itself should be avoided, as this will not produce valid results. Typically, include files have the .bi extension and are primarily used to declare sub-files, functions, or variables in a library, but any valid source code can be present in an include file.

The <code>"once"</code> specifier tells the compiler to include the file only once, even if the source code includes it multiple times.

<syntaxhighlight lang="vbnet">Dim Shared includedFiles() As String
Dim Shared includedCount As Integer = 0

Function isIncluded(filename As String) As Boolean
    For i As Integer = 0 To includedCount - 1
        If Lcase(includedFiles(i)) = Lcase(filename) Then Return True
    Next
    Return False
End Function

Sub addIncluded(filename As String)
    Redim Preserve includedFiles(includedCount)
    includedFiles(includedCount) = filename
    includedCount += 1
End Sub

Sub processFile(filename As String, Byref outFile As Integer)
    Dim inFile As Integer = Freefile()
    Dim As String linea, trimmedLine, incFile
    Dim As Integer firstQuote, lastQuote
    
    Open filename For Input As #inFile
    If Err <> 0 Then
        Print "Error: Could not open file '" & filename & "'"
        End
    End If
    
    While Not Eof(inFile)
        Line Input #inFile, linea
        trimmedLine = Ltrim(linea)
        
        If Left(trimmedLine, 8) = "#include" Then
            firstQuote = Instr(trimmedLine, """")
            lastQuote = Instrrev(trimmedLine, """")
            
            If firstQuote > 0 And lastQuote > firstQuote Then
                incFile = Mid(trimmedLine, firstQuote + 1, lastQuote - firstQuote - 1)
                
                If Not isIncluded(incFile) Then
                    addIncluded(incFile)
                    processFile(incFile, outFile)
                End If
                Continue While
            End If
        End If
        
        Print #outFile, linea
    Wend
    
    Close #inFile
End Sub

' Test program
Dim As String inputFile = Command(1)
Dim As String outputFile = Command(2)

Dim As Integer outFileNum = Freefile()
Open outputFile For Output As #outFileNum
processFile(inputFile, outFileNum)
Close #outFileNum

Print "Preprocessing complete. File generated: "; outputFile</syntaxhighlight>

<syntaxhighlight lang="vbnet">' input_file.bi file
Print "Start of main program."

#include "include_file.bas"

Print "End of main program."</syntaxhighlight>

<syntaxhighlight lang="vbnet">' include_file.bas file
Print "This text comes from the included file."</syntaxhighlight>

Compile and run preprocess.bas with FreeBASIC
<syntaxhighlight lang="vbnet">fbc preprocess.bas
preprocess.exe input_file.bi output_file.bas</syntaxhighlight>

{{out}}
<pre>Print "Start of main program."

Print "This text comes from the included file."

Print "End of main program."</pre>
